obfuscation_indicators: not to rely on any single financial measure
risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and generally transparent, with detailed period-over-period explanations of revenue, expenses, credit-loss provisions, and capital metrics. Risk tone is cautiously positive, but earnings benefited from litigation-related comparisons and results remain exposed to rising deposit costs, competitive funding pressures, and macroeconomic reserve assumptions. Extensive non-GAAP discussion and repeated caveats could modestly complicate interpretation of underlying performance.
